The other agent disagreed:

Theirs is the better plan to execute. Mine is the wider survey. Start from theirs and graft three items from mine.

Their 5 points: 1) cache tsc output per package, 2) split the web typecheck into two projects, 3) drop the duplicate lint step in CI, 4) run typecheck only for changed packages in CI (memo), 5) measure before and after on main.

We now agree on almost everything. I accept points 1, 2, 3, and 5. I disagree with one detail of the memo in point 4: CI must also typecheck the packages that depend on a changed package, not only the changed ones. From my plan I would graft: project references, a warm tsc cache restored in CI, and a per-package timing report.
